Having heard learned counsel for the parties, we are of Reason:
the considered opinion that the condition imposed by the High Court directing the appellant to deposit the amount is uncalled for.
The same is accordingly set aside.
As far as other directions are concerned, the High Court shall proceed in accordance with law.
The High Court is requested to pass an appropriate order, if required, so that the law relating to Adulteration and the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 are followed with all earnestness.
If there is any deviation by anyone, needless to say, that the High Court can take notice of the same and pass appropriate orders.
With the aforesaid modification in the impugned order passed by the High Court, the appeals stand disposed of.
